capabilities: Preview a note with a single click and pin the tab with a double click
Color files and folders green or gray by archive status
Show note tags as colored badges in the file explorer
Toggle minimal file and folder navigation icons
Assign a color per tag for file names and badges
disambiguation: Not a code editor or coding environment; it only restyles tabs, file explorer coloring, tag badges and icons.
extras: Requires Obsidian desktop 1.8.9 or newer. Ships an optional CSS snippet described as personal-style and not tested with other themes. README is available in Chinese and English.
intentEvidence: Make Obsidian work like VS Code.
problem: Obsidian's tabs and file explorer lack quick preview-and-pin tab behavior and give no at-a-glance signal of which notes are archived or which tags they carry.

relations.evidence: Make Obsidian work like VS Code.

summary: Plugin that gives Obsidian VS Code-style preview tabs, archive-based file coloring, tag badges and minimal file explorer icons.
